mapper.select: select user_uuid from comment_reply where id = #{replyId} and status = 1 limit 1

select cr.id, cr.root_comment_id as rootCommentId, cr.parent_reply_id as parentReplyId, cr.user_uuid as userUuid, u.nickname as nickname, cr.target_user_uuid as targetUserUuid, tu.nickname as targetNickname, cr.content, cr.like_count as likeCount, cr.created_at as createdAt from comment_reply cr left join user u on cr.user_uuid = u.uuid left join user tu on cr.target_user_uuid = tu.uuid where cr.root_comment_id = #{commentId} and cr.status = 1 order by cr.created_at asc
mapper.update: update comment_reply set like_count = like_count + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{replyId} and status = 1
update comment_reply set like_count = case when like_count > 0 then like_count - 1 else 0 end, updated_at = now() where id = #{replyId} and status = 1
